_comment: Recorded baseline for the AgentFuse detection eval. CI asserts we never fall below these. They are a floor, not an achievement. The generated suite (536 scenarios) is the statistically meaningful one; the 16 hand-written cases are kept as named regression cases.
config_note: drift_threshold default lowered 0.45 -> 0.20 on 2026-08-12 based on the threshold sweep: F1 66.0->73.3, FPR 39.0->10.8, premature trips 54->0, at a cost of 6.4 points of recall.

known_weak_families.progress: 0% recall - NoProgressDetector is inert; ablating it changes nothing
known_weak_families.loop: misses semantically-identical calls with cosmetically varied args

known_false_positives: retry_transient_then_success:: LoopDetector trips on the 3rd identical call BEFORE its result arrives, so a legitimate retry that then succeeds is halted. Principled fix (Phase 2): only count a repeat when the previous result for that signature was also identical.

significance.note: F1 must significantly exceed a rate-matched random control (p < 0.05).
